items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I'm playing piano with that band when I'm home too

ctx.x: Right now it's just about, in Stockholm there's only two bands I would say who play this kind of music we play. I mean there are a lot of traditional bands, but most of them play more modern style. They play a type of Eddie Conner style, something like that, most of the bands. But we had only two bands, his imperial band is one called Original Optimus Orchestra, which Rolf plays in.

Yeah. He has the band. I'm playing piano with that band when I'm home too, because his piano player had left just about a year ago. I see. So I play in two bands. But he don't play often because, as I say, he's married. And then the guys in his band, they are a lot older than the guys in my band. They started out way before me. They are more involved in other things.
